label: Athena++ · χ 100 · level 3 · periodic on all faces, 100 R box
note: All six faces are periodic, but the box is 100 R long and reaches 97 R downstream, so no gas comes back around within 5 t_cc; the pictures show the standard window up to 17 R. By t = 5 t_cc no gas denser than a third of the initial cloud is left.
